# SVG visual concepts

These files preserve exploratory, hand-authored SVG artwork from an older GUI branch.

- [`gui-semantic-boundary.svg`](../assets/concepts/gui-semantic-boundary.svg) illustrates the intended separation between semantic GUI data and platform manifestations. Its animation is authored directly in SVG/CSS.
- [`living-energy-vortex.svg`](../assets/concepts/living-energy-vortex.svg) is an animated visual experiment around a digital-eye/energy-field motif.

**Evidence boundary:** neither file is generated by `SvgGuiRenderer`, nor does either prove that the current GUI framework produces animated or interactive SVG scenes. Treat them as design concepts and visual assets only. Framework behavior must be demonstrated by generated output and automated or hosted tests. Check accessibility, reduced-motion behavior, browser rendering, and local references before using them as release evidence.
